method: Theil–Sen flat-bottom baseline slopes and median caplines measured after four-times Lanczos sampling; fitted bounds are converted back to native pixel coordinates. One uniform scale per physical source page; independent row baselines; no individual glyph-height normalization.

regular-6-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.

regular-6-census-n.note: Independent baseline for the distant numeral block. Observed baseline figures anchor one rigid transform; all figures retain their source-relative positions at the same physical page scale. No individual figure height or baseline normalization.
